{{Top|leg}}
The '''HSP-10 pursuit [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]]''' was an air patrol model employed on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] by the early [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]]. With a maximum speed of 620 [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] per hour, it required a single [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] and could carry three passengers; it was fully enclosed. It was capable of carrying half a ton of cargo and consumables for one day. The pilot could operate a double [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]] and an [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannon]]. A new craft cost 40,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]], but a used one only cost 20,000.
